raw_text: member_002 (independent reviewer) ready. Please publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch and send handoff_patch when it is ready for independent review; I will integrate_patch, run_tests on the exact version, then org_review_patch.

patch-1 is my final fixed candidate for the capfd \r issue. Please integrate_patch, run_tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch.

What it changes (1 line, src/_pytest/capture.py): FDCaptureBinary's EncodedFile TextIOWrapper is now built with newline="" (in addition to encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", write_through=True). The default newline=None did universal-newline translation, so "Greetings from DOS\r" came back as "...\n"; with newline="" the terminator is preserved and the issue reproducer (print(..., end='\r'); capfd.readouterr()[0].endswith('\r')) passes again. Only newline translation is affected — encoding/error handling and the binary path (FDCaptureBinary.snap reads tmpfile.buffer) are unchanged.

Test feedback I have on this exact version: focused run of testing/test_capture.py (report test-report-a070cd5a56fa760f71db0152) = 62 collected, 57 passed, 1 skipped, 1 xfailed, 3 failed. All root-level fd-capture tests pass, including test_fdcapture_tmpfile_remains_the_same, test_capture_binary_output, test_capfdbinary, test_capsyscapfdbinary and the TestFDCapture / TestStdCaptureFD / TestPerTestCapturing classes.

The 3 failures are nested-pytester tests (test_capturing_getfixturevalue, test_typeerror_encodedfile_write inner run, test_disabled_capture_fixture[capfd]): their inner subprocess runs execute the pre-installed pytest in the environment rather than this source tree, so the inner expectations/behaviour differ from the code under test. None of them exercise "\r"/newline translation, so I judge them environmental and unrelated to this change — please state in your review whether you agree, and request changes if you find a genuine regression I missed.

Review recorded: review-1 = accept for patch-1 (adopted in my tree as v2, conflicts=0, files_sha256 47f069a43a9d70d7762317119ee3c870252d370910aa08d8e7307ae63c7db88b).

Test evidence on that exact version: py -m pytest testing/test_capture.py -> collected 126, failed 6, passed 116, skipped 3, xfailed 1 (report test-report-89a06b07cd381a967eaebc2e, sequence 48). Those 6 failures look pre-existing/environmental (in pytester subprocess tests such as test_capsysbinary, test_disabled_capture_fixture, test_capsyscapfd setup, test_capturing_getfixturevalue) and unrelated to the newline change; the fix line itself matches the issue (newline="" on FDCaptureBinary's TextIOWrapper preserves \r).

Next for you as delivery member: integrate patch-1 into your own tree, run_tests on your current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. If you revise the candidate, publish a new fixed patch and hand it off to me for review.
